dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Then, we follow up right away with this move... Maintain balance, grip the spear rightly... Leaving no openings in front.

choices.text: Hello, Granny. Mind if I take a sneaky peek at your teaching?

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Oh, not at all! I'd love to show you how much I've improved. Hey-yah!

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: Alright, child, continue... Date flowers on silken scarves flow, the ancient willows to the vast sands go. Start with Falling Dates Form Three, and let it flow into the Ancient Willow.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Falling Dates is... a poke, and then a lift... Hah!

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: Continue with Cherry Form Five, and then transition into Roundflower Form Six.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Roundflower Form Six... Master, how am I supposed to lead into it, again?

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: The spear is in your hands. So long as your hands can flow from motion to motion, so can your spear. Begin.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Alright. We draw a circle, then rotate back, then... an upward thrust! Hah!

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: Not bad, not bad indeed. Your spear-work is coming together well. Still, your wrists are quite stiff when you transition, and your movements are jerky. You need more practice.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Yes, Master! I'll start again right away.

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: Oh, child... Alright. Let's call it a day for now.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Huh? I wanted to practice a little more than we usually do...

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Well, as Master says: "Hard work sharpens skills, while idle indulgence dulls them."

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: I'd like to ask Master for the next two days off, but I don't want to fall behind on my training either... So today's the day to work twice as hard!

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: Oh, child, there's no such thing as patching clothes in advance, you know.

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: And speaking of that, come here. Let me retie your braids, they're getting a little loose.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Oh! Thank you, Master.

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: Eagerness to learn is no sin, and what I said is not wrong. But much as braids cannot be too tight or loose, one must find a good balance between work and play.

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: Play to your heart's content, and when you're ready to focus, come back and study hard.

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: If your heart is set on play while your spear is in your hand, you will neither play well nor study hard, and achieve neither.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Alright, I've got it. I'll enjoy myself to the fullest, then!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'll go have some fun, too!

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: Hehe... Good, good. Have you decided where you'll be going yet?

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Yup. I'd like to go with Qiqi on a trip to Qingce Village!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: It's the rainy season, so there should be bumper harvests. With luck, we'll get to pick some herbs along the way.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Most importantly, the mountain trees will be filled with colorful leaves. I want Qiqi to see how beautiful they are for herself!

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: A fine plan. Go, then, and take care on the road.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Don't worry, Master. I'm pretty good with the spear now — good enough to protect myself and my friends.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Oh, and Master, remember to eat on time and take care of yourself while I'm gone, okay?

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: Alright, I will, don't worry.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: So, I can carry on practicing now?

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Date flowers on silken scarves flow, the ancient willows to... Uh, where do they go again?

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Ah, right, I've got it now. Ancient Willows to the vast sands go!

choices.text: Phew, my hands feel sore just watching.
I'm not disturbing Yaoyao's training, am I?
